final: WITH v AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS vol FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, vol, vol * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(vol) FROM v) AS share FROM v), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.vol) AS combined_volume, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
